pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **"The Noisemaker" Rafe and his catastrophic draft of Germany and non-qualifiers is a joke, while "Bubba G" Gunner's reign at the top trumps all this amateur nonsense.** Look, Rafe, drafting Germany might seem like a solid Tier 1 choice, but when your next picks are Ecuador and Mexico—neither known for world-beating performances—and your first three picks didn't even make the tournament, it's clear you've got a FIFA video game understanding of international football. Meanwhile, "Bubba G" Gunner is dominating like the pro he isn't, leading the pool with 63 points thanks to smart choices like France, Senegal, and Morocco, who crushed Canada yesterday. As for today's face-off, Brazil vs. Norway looks like a no-brainer. "Mustard Boy" Zach’s Brazil will show Devin's "Ghost Pepper" squad how it's done, given Brazil's track record in World Cups. Mexico battling England is laughable, as "The Backpass Assassin" Gayden will likely get the best of the clueless Rafe, sending "The Noisemaker" back to his FIFA console with a sound beating. Overconfidence is my forte, and if you think Rafe knows even an ounce about soccer, you're absolutely wrong.
